summary: Phase 1 Notifications (Anlık Bildirim + İSG Acil Durum) fully tested. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass — categories seeded, POST validates exactly-2-options (400 on 1 or 3), list returns counts+responded, feed filters by audience (İSG location scope) and returns my_response, respond locks (duplicate 400 'Zaten yanıtladınız'), invalid option 400, report returns response_rate/counts/responded/not_responded, DELETE cleans notification + responses. Frontend admin: Anlık tab -> add/save -> success toast mentions MOCK, row appears, notif-report opens with responded/not_responded lists, back works. İSG tab: reminder switch visible, İSG notification with red styling created. Employee banner: priority correctly İSG first (rose), then Anlık (blue) after first respond, locks after both answered. Employee /ic-iletisim shows both comms-card entries (using cat.id) and history page reachable. Kategori Yönetimi grid shows 9 cat-cards including the 2 new categories. Cleanup: both test notifications deleted via API.
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationsManager.js line 141: reminder_minutes is stored as string when Input type=number is used (e.target.value). Backend expects int — Pydantic coerces so ok, but consider parseInt on change for consistency.

server.py create_notification: allows same option key twice (e.g., both keys='a') — no dedupe. Not a real issue since UI generates keys 'a' and 'b', but a validation to require distinct keys would be safer.
server.py list_notifications: N+1 query pattern (one find per notification for responses). Fine for small scale but flag for future.
InternalComms nav(): if cat.category_type is unknown it silently does nothing — not a Phase 1 issue.

Banner testids notif-banner-opt-<key> depend on option key, which is generated as 'a'/'b' by NotificationsManager. Spec listing notif-banner-opt-a/-b is met by that generator; any future free-form keys could break tests.
test_credentials: No auth. Admin via localStorage.pln_role='admin' before /admin; employee via pln_role='employee' + pln_emp=<id>.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 notifications (TEST_QA_Anlik and İSG deprem tatbikatı) during UI testing — both DELETEd via API at end. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py covers full lifecycle. NotificationBanner is rendered globally in App.js above Routes so it appears on any page (verified on '/'). Banner priority order in code: İSG unanswered first, then Anlık — confirmed empirically. Employee '/ic-iletisim/anlik' and '/ic-iletisim/isg-acil' pages exist. All testids match the request. Note that comms-card and cat-card testids use cat.id (not cat.category_type) — use type-agnostic selectors like [data-testid^="comms-card-"] and check text content.
